title: Juanita NDE-Like Experience 7377 NDE 7377
content: It is a very short little experience, but I'm glad to share it. Actually I did not die, but I know it was the prelude to it. Although death did not touch me, in this manner I confirm that the experiences of my peers are real. I was a child, and I was sad, depressed. I suddenly felt like I was leaving and the strength to live left me. I lay next to my mother. I felt tired. Suddenly, I felt like I was shot out of my body. I bolted fast, flying into the midst of an endless ocean of light; going very fast. I felt that I traveled a great distance, when, inside me I knew I was reaching a limit after which would be Jesus, God. From the time I was a child I was very much a believer. If I crossed, I would not come back. I felt a desire to follow, but an inner voice told me and made me understand that I was not ready to go there, that there were still things I must learn, and I, myself, then thought, ‘I'm not ready, I must return.’ I immediately woke up in bed, startled, as if I had fallen into the body, lamenting that I was back, but it was my higher consciousness, which returned me. Now I know. Thanks for reading.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt 'shot out of my body' and 'bolted fast, flying'.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Flying rapidly into an 'endless ocean of light' (no tunnel described).
tunnel.movement_other_detail: Described as being 'shot out' and 'bolted fast, flying' and 'going very fast' over a great distance.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: She sensed a limit after which would be 'Jesus, God,' but did not report meeting them.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: NDE-like episode while a sad/depressed child lying next to mother; she states she 'did not die' and felt it was a 'prelude' to death.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Also includes rapid flight/movement through a luminous expanse ('endless ocean of light') and an 'inner voice' advising return.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE separation followed by rapid movement into light; sensed a boundary/limit; chose to return; immediate awakening in bed.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Described as NDE-like and explicitly 'did not die'; experience framed as a 'prelude' to death. Mentions 'higher consciousness' returning her.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I felt like I was shot out of my body.” “flying into the midst of an endless ocean of light; going very fast.” “I knew I was reaching a limit after which would be Jesus, God.” “I'm not ready, I must return.”
